Let \(u=p^2\ge 0\). From the constraint,
\[
d^2=\frac{36}{1+\frac{p^2}{16}}=\frac{576}{u+16}.
\]
The distance to minimize is
\[
\frac{p^2+d^2}{16}
=\frac{u+\frac{576}{u+16}}{16}.
\]
Minimize
\[
g(u)=u+\frac{576}{u+16}.
\]
Then
\[
g'(u)=1-\frac{576}{(u+16)^2}.
\]
Set \(g'(u)=0\):
\[
(u+16)^2=576 \implies u+16=24 \implies u=8.
\]
Thus the minimum distance is
\[
\frac{8+\frac{576}{24}}{16}
=\frac{8+24}{16}=2.
\]
\[
\boxed{2}
\]
